Sofia, the door 6 lamp delivery was **Pellow Home Living** (the renamed Covey & Lark Retail account), not Pellucid Harbor Logistics.

The February 17 thread in #coastal-team settles it. Kwame confirmed your retail account was the one showing the lamp delivery at door 6, not the container pickup, and you confirmed that. Pellucid is the Gulf Coast terminal account. I've posted this as a reply in your thread.
